verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an Agent API with tools, multi-step reasoning, and delegation of multi-step work to Computer via MCP. These are all one-off, request-driven runs invoked by the caller. Nothing documents setting up scheduled, recurring, or trigger-based automations that run in the background without the user's own orchestration, which would be a user-side workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
